# Chris Kmelier — Developer Portfolio

> A single-page developer portfolio for Chris Kmelier (GitHub @Kmelier). Projects,
> statistics and recent activity are fetched live from the public GitHub REST API at
> page load rather than hard-coded, so the content reflects the account's current state.

The site is a client-rendered React single-page app with no server component and no
database. Every section below is an anchor on the one page at https://kmelier.vercel.app,
not a separate document, so a crawler that fetches the root URL has the whole site.
Because the project and statistics content arrives from the GitHub API after first paint,
tools that read only the initial HTML will not see it; read it from the API links below
instead.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kmelier.vercel.app): the entire site — hero, about, projects, skills, GitHub activity, journey, achievements and contact.
- [#about](https://kmelier.vercel.app/#about): short biography and profile details.
- [#projects](https://kmelier.vercel.app/#projects): project cards built from the account's public repositories, with a per-project detail dialog deep-linkable as `#/project/<repo-name>`.
- [#skills](https://kmelier.vercel.app/#skills): technologies grouped by area, with the language mix derived from repository data.
- [#github](https://kmelier.vercel.app/#github): profile card, repository and star counts, recent public events, and a twelve-week activity heatmap.
- [#journey](https://kmelier.vercel.app/#journey): timeline of milestones.
- [#achievements](https://kmelier.vercel.app/#achievements): aggregate statistics.
- [#contact](https://kmelier.vercel.app/#contact): email and social links.

## Data sources

- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/Kmelier): the canonical source for everything on the site.
- [Public user API](https://api.github.com/users/Kmelier): name, bio, followers, public repository count.
- [Public repositories API](https://api.github.com/users/Kmelier/repos): the exact list the projects grid is built from; the repository named `Portfolio` is filtered out because it is this site.
- [Public events API](https://api.github.com/users/Kmelier/events/public): the source for the recent-activity list and the heatmap. GitHub retains roughly 90 days here, which is why the heatmap covers twelve weeks and not a full year.

## About this site

- [Source repository](https://github.com/Kmelier/Portfolio): React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4 and Anime.js, deployed on Vercel.
- [Web app manifest](https://kmelier.vercel.app/manifest.webmanifest): installable to a phone home screen; standalone display, dark theme colour.

## Contact

- [Contact section](https://kmelier.vercel.app/#contact): email and social links. The
  address is deliberately not spelled out in this file — it is already reachable on the
  page, and repeating it in a plain-text file written for crawlers only makes it easier
  to harvest.
